question: As of 31 July 2025, who holds the record for most Asian Games medals by an Indian athlete?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PT Usha**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **PT Usha**, often referred to as the "Queen of Indian Track and Field," holds the record for the most **Asian Games medals by an Indian athlete**. 
• She won a total of **11 medals** at the **Asian Games**, including 4 gold medals, 7 silver medals, and no bronze medals. 
• Her performance at the **1986 Seoul Asian Games** was particularly remarkable, where she won 4 golds and 1 silver in track and field events. 
• PT Usha competed in multiple editions of the Asian Games, including **1982, 1986, 1990, and 1994**, showcasing her consistency and dominance in athletics. 
• She specialized in **sprints and hurdles**, becoming an icon for Indian athletics and inspiring generations of athletes. 
• PT Usha's achievements earned her numerous accolades, including the **Arjuna Award in 1984** and the **Padma Shri in 1985**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Asian Games Overview:** 
• The **Asian Games**, also known as the Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every 4 years, featuring athletes from across Asia. 
• India has participated in the Asian Games since its inception in **1951**, when the first games were held in New Delhi, India. 
• Indian athletes have excelled in sports like hockey, kabaddi, wrestling, and athletics at the Asian Games. 
• **PT Usha's Career Highlights:** 
• PT Usha was born in **Kerala**, India, in **1964**. She began her athletic career at a young age and quickly rose to prominence. 
• She narrowly missed a medal at the **1984 Los Angeles Olympics**, finishing fourth in the 400m hurdles final by just 0.01 seconds. 
• Her achievements earned her the nickname "**Payyoli Express**" due to her incredible speed and her hometown of Payyoli in Kerala. 
• **Other Indian Athletes at the Asian Games:** 
• **KD Jadhav:** India's first individual Olympic medalist but did not have significant achievements at the Asian Games. 
• **Sachin Nag:** A swimmer who won medals at the 1951 Asian Games but did not reach PT Usha's level of dominance. 
• **Dutee Chand:** A contemporary sprinter who has won medals at the Asian Games but does not hold the record for the most medals. 
• **Important Facts about Indian Athletics:** 
• Indian athletes have contributed significantly to the country's medal tally at the Asian Games, especially in track and field events. 
• India's athletics legacy includes stars like **Milkha Singh**, **Anju Bobby George**, and **Neeraj Chopra**, alongside PT Usha. 
• PT Usha's dominance at the Asian Games remains unparalleled, showcasing her dedication and skill in athletics. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Indian Athletics at International Events:** 
• PT Usha's near-miss at the **1984 Olympics** remains one of the most discussed moments in Indian athletics history. 
• India continues to produce world-class athletes, with **Neeraj Chopra** winning the gold medal in javelin at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**. 
• PT Usha now serves as a mentor and coach, contributing to the development of the next generation of Indian athletes. </ul
